backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows. Core uses canonical snapshots; Space variants use exp-20260510-028 augmented Space snapshots. The accepted_before variant reproduces exp-20260512-038 policy semantics.
decision_rationale: The financing/dilution event-guard profile scalar improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion must stay shared and metadata-only with live Space slots at zero.

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies built from a 2026-05-10 research universe. Registry event_guard_profile metadata is production-observable, but any accepted change must remain default-off until forward evidence matures.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: scale only official Space signals whose event_guard_profile includes financing or dilution.

2_history_check.exp-20260512-038: Accepted customer-source 1.10x scalar; this is the fixed before state.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: space_financing_dilution_event_guard_profile_risk_scalar. Candidate pool, accepted Space risk scalars, targets, stops, ranking, add-ons, LLM/news, and live slots stay fixed.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least 2/3 improved EV windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 total trades, and nonzero adjusted profile-qualified signals.

hypothesis: After accepting liquidity-tier and customer-source Space catalyst quality scalars, the next orthogonal production-observable field is downside financing/dilution sensitivity. Signals whose registry profile names that risk may need a smaller or different default-off risk budget even when other Space quality fields are positive.
interpretation: The financing/dilution event-guard profile scalar improved the accepted default-off Space stack under the three-window gate. Promotion must stay shared and metadata-only with live Space slots at zero.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space event-state forward data remains below the closed-decision gate; this run uses deterministic production registry metadata.

next_evidence_needed: Do not retry adjacent financing/dilution event-guard profile scalars on these frozen snapshots. Future Space profile work needs forward replacement value or a genuinely different production-observable catalyst-quality field.
single_causal_variable: risk scalar for official Space signals whose production registry event_guard_profile contains financing or dilution
why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking is data-limited; SEC paper work needs forward outcomes; GSAT and mature satcom candidate expansions are rejected; recent Space TQS, IWM, peer, theme, liquidity, and customer-source variants are accepted context or anti-repeat.
